_comment: Kanada-malja (games/kanadamalja): the board game's clips; the Finnish ones and the place names (said in Finnish in every language) are in voice/fi.json.

clips.km_avaa: Open the token? Pay one hundred euros, or try your luck with the die.
clips.km_malja: You found the Kanada Cup! Take it to Nokia Areena!
clips.km_makkara: A black sausage! It gets you out of jail.
clips.km_makkara_voitto: A black sausage! Now it counts too. Take it to Nokia Areena before the cup!
clips.km_kummola: Kummola! You get three hundred euros.
clips.km_raipe: Raipe! You get six hundred euros.
clips.km_barkov: Barkov! You get one thousand euros!
clips.km_rosvo: Oh no! A robber took all your money.
clips.km_poliisi: The police take you to jail.
clips.km_putka: Get out with a fine, a black sausage, or by rolling five or six.
clips.km_makkara_vapaa: The guard got the sausage. You are free!
clips.km_ratikka: Ding ding! The tram is leaving.
clips.km_voitti_ilves: Ilves wins! The Kanada Cup is at Nokia Areena!
clips.km_voitti_tappara: Tappara wins! The Kanada Cup is at Nokia Areena!
clips.km_valitse_joukkue: Which team are you, Ilves or Tappara?
clips.km_ohje: Roll the die and choose where to go. On a big spot you can open the token. Find the Kanada Cup and be the first to take it to Nokia Areena.
